gruss_morgen.text: No time, no time! Morning mail! Eighteen letters, three parcels, one suspiciously buzzing box! ... Fine, two minutes.

gruss_tag.text: Eilfried, postman, extremely stressed! You can tell by my walk! ... It's always like that, but the stress is REAL.

gruss_abend.text: Final round of the day! The last round I walk slowly. Well... more slowly. It's complicated with my feet.

gruss_regen.text: Rain! AT LAST! Best delivery weather! For me. The letters disagree, but they sit in the waterproof bag.

gruss_freund.text: Oh! YOU! For you I always have time! Strike that from the record, I NEVER have time. For you I make time. Out of nothing!

text: News? I AM the news! Everything this valley knows went through my bag!
Strictly confidential, of course. I don't read anything. I just... weigh very attentively.
Forty kilometers waddled today already! Okay, four. But in duck kilometers that's A LOT.
The conversion rate is one to ten. I set it myself. As the competent authority.
You know, I always take an extra break at your place. Officially because of the heavy bag.
Unofficially... you're the best address in the valley. Don't tell the other addresses!

quest_vergabe.text: YES! Special dispatch! Express delivery! And my feet are... thematically opposed today. Will you take over?

quest_annahme.text: MAGNIFICENT! You are hereby honorary assistant postman! The cap comes at five hearts, that's civil service law!

ablehnung.text: Understood, understood! Then the dispatch goes into interim storage. Under my hat. There's a surprising amount of room.

quest_abgabe.text: Delivered and signed for! CLEAN work! You get my golden postmark! It's made of potato, but painted GOLD!

geschenk_liebt.text: A COOKIE! Provisions for the road! You understand the postal service at heart! It will be ceremonially consumed at kilometer two!

geschenk_mag.text: For me? No sender? Then I get to keep it, paragraph seven! My favorite paragraph!

geschenk_normal.text: Oh! Thanks! I classify this as... a small parcel of affection. Postage due from the recipient: one smile. Here you go!

text: The strangest parcel? A box, addressed to The fastest animal in the valley. No name. Nothing.
I walked around for three days asking. The hare said it was him. The horse said it was him. Embarrassing for both.
In the end it turned out: the box was for ME. From my mother. Slippers. She knows me well.
Why a postman? Little Eilfried couldn't fly. All the ducks flew away in autumn — I stayed on the ground.
I cried until the old postman said: son, if you can't fly, you'd better carry important things.
Now I carry important things every day. And in autumn? The others wave from above. I wave back with letters.

tschuess.text: Onwards! The mail never rests! At most it takes... strategic waddle breaks! BYE!
